hypothesis: The E30 candidate—lower-body policy actions with delayed 1.5 acceleration-strength authority—will satisfy every absolute, destructive-control, and causal recovery criterion across the complete locked product bundle.

shared.action_axis: mesh-component parent-bind axis from first policy

validity_gates: Exactly three unique Normal and three unique ZeroActions repetitions plus both destructive controls are complete PRODUCT_RUN fixtures.
All runs use one binary and the locked protocol SHA256 75b29360907028d081cbfa43e965a35fef760873c76d71b52f2147e99f54606a.
Normal runs record strength 1.0 at capture and 1.5 thereafter; ZeroActions remains 1.0.
Normal uses nonzero lower-only policy actions; ZeroActions remains exactly zero.
Target readback is at least 0.95 and render/raw streams are complete.
DropControlDispatch fails target_readback and ForcedSupportLoss fails support_gap or runtime_state.
product_candidate_pass: All three Normal repetitions pass absolute criteria, both controls fail for intended reasons, and median Normal recovery AUC / median ZeroActions recovery AUC <= 0.8.
falsification: Any malformed run, Normal absolute failure, destructive-control mismatch, or recovery ratio above 0.8.
promotion_rule: A passing development-flag bundle authorizes implementing lower-only policy compatibility and 1.5 policy-mode authority as explicit product behavior, followed by a second complete bundle with no experimental flags.
next: If PASS, promote behavior through TDD and run the no-flag product bundle.
